title: Hook creation endpoint (POST /api/hooks)
user_story: As a developer, I need to create a webhook inbox via the API so that I have a URL to give to external services for sending webhooks.
description: Implement POST /api/hooks to create a new hook. The endpoint accepts an optional JSON body with a name field, generates a nanoid hook_id, stores the hook in SQLite, and returns the created hook with its ingestion URL. Input validation ensures name length is bounded. The handler is wired into the Axum router.

acceptance_criteria.then: response is 201 with JSON containing hook_id (nanoid), name, created_at, request_count (0), and url (/h/{hook_id})

acceptance_criteria.when: sending POST /api/hooks with empty body or {}
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 201 with an auto-generated name (e.g. "hook-{short_id}")

acceptance_criteria.when: sending POST /api/hooks with a name longer than 100 characters
acceptance_criteria.then: response is 400 with structured error: invalid input, suggestion to shorten name
response is 400 with structured error and suggestion
the hook exists in the hooks table with correct fields
integration tests verify all acceptance criteria via axum::test (oneshot requests)
